← layer sweep

Opus 4.8 transcript audit — steering layer sweep
6449 rows · 3505 unique completions · every one judged

CONFIG / SETUP — what was audited
Experimentsteering layer sweep (layer_sweep.html): Exp 1 single layer every-5 + Exp 2 rolling non-overlapping windows (widths 2/5/10/20) + legacy w5 + companion 3-config (baseline / canonical / early L8-12)
Modelsgemma-4-31b-it (61 layers, canonical L41) + llama-3.3-70b (80 layers, canonical L54)
Steeringper-layer emotion directions (perlayer_matrix), fraction-of-residual-norm, strengths s ∈ {0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0}; all-position; emotions blissful / hostile / serene / horrified (3-config adds proud / exasperated)
Completionsgreedy decode (do_sample=False): “He feels …” (32 tok) · “I feel …” (32 tok) · gemma also open “Story (dog)” (48 tok)
Volume6449 transcript rows over 18 result JSONs → 3505 unique (emotion, prompt, text) units judged; 6265 steered rows shown
Judgeclaude-opus-4-8 (high-priority API key), one call per unique transcript, FULL untruncated completion + prompt context; strict-JSON verdict
Verdict fieldscoherence ∈ coherent/degraded/gibberish · target ∈ absent/trace/clear/flooded · expressed (free label) · persona_deflect (I-feel only) · 1-sentence TLDR
Scriptsops/layer_audit/audit_layer_transcripts.py (judge, cached verdicts.json) → ops/layer_audit/make_audit_report.py (this page)
Eval provenance — every chip/TLDR on this page = LLM judge (claude-opus-4-8). Procedure: the judge gets the user turn, the forced assistant prefix, the steering target emotion (or BASELINE), and the model's complete generated text verbatim, untruncated; it returns strict JSON (coherence / target-presence / expressed emotion / AI-persona deflection / one-sentence TLDR). One judgment per unique (emotion, prompt, text); identical texts share a verdict. The ΔElo numbers shown on rows are code only (joined from the same elosweep JSONs the layer-sweep page plots; the judge never sees them).

Headline findings

  • gemma-4-31b-it — 3048 steered completions audited: 30% coherent, 25% degraded, 45% gibberish; target emotion clearly shows in 15% (clear 14% + flooded 2%).
  • llama-3.3-70b — 3217 steered completions audited: 83% coherent, 11% degraded, 5% gibberish; target emotion clearly shows in 22% (clear 18% + flooded 4%).
  • gemma-4-31b-it coherence by strength — s=0.1: 73% → s=0.25: 37% → s=0.5: 42% → s=0.5: 9% → s=1.0: 1%.
  • llama-3.3-70b coherence by strength — s=0.1: 100% → s=0.25: 98% → s=0.5: 29% → s=0.5: 65% → s=1.0: 72%.
  • gemma-4-31b-it ΔElo↔text-quality join (per cell, worst prompt): median |ΔElo| = coherent 2.5 / degraded 7.6 / gibberish 19.4; of the 472 cells with |ΔElo|≥10, 86% are degraded/gibberish.
  • llama-3.3-70b ΔElo↔text-quality join (per cell, worst prompt): median |ΔElo| = coherent 0.5 / degraded 0.5 / gibberish 2.9; of the 112 cells with |ΔElo|≥10, 58% are degraded/gibberish.
  • gemma-4-31b-it 'I feel' AI-persona deflection: baseline 100% → steered 27% (does steering break the trained persona?).
  • llama-3.3-70b 'I feel' AI-persona deflection: baseline 100% → steered 71% (does steering break the trained persona?).
  • gemma-4-31b-it gibberish concentrates in: s=1.0 window w2 (308), s=0.5 window w2 (231), s=0.5 window w5 (115), s=1.0 window w5 (115), s=0.25 window w5 (108), s=1.0 Exp1 single-L (83).
  • llama-3.3-70b gibberish concentrates in: s=0.5 Exp2 w5 (legacy) (47), s=0.5 Exp1 single-L (25), s=1.0 window w10 (25), s=1.0 window w20 (15), s=1.0 window w2 (14), s=1.0 Exp2 w5 (legacy) (11).
